caption: swipe for the week the sky had, from dec 29 to today. one of these is about your love life.

slides.headline: what just happened in the *sky* over new year?
the sun and mercury both hit *saturn*
slides.body: sun square saturn, then mercury square saturn. read it as the year-end reality check: the plan met the calendar.

slides.headline: last quarter in *libra*: the clear-out moon
slides.body: the half-lit moon before a new one. astrologers read it as a time to let go of what's unfair, not just what's old.

slides.headline: new year's eve got a *mars* boost
slides.body: the sun and mercury both trined mars in virgo. a good night to do, not just plan. hope you did something.

slides.headline: the year opened with the sun on *mercury*
slides.body: they lined up in capricorn on jan 1. read it as a clear head for resolutions. write yours in one sentence.

slides.headline: *venus* squares jupiter today: easy on the promises
slides.body: an overdo aspect. lovely for a big night, risky for a big vow. you can mean it next week too.

slides.headline: resolution: say the *honest* thing first
slides.body: save this. the week ahead lands tomorrow.
